description:
Update an existing contact group in Holded. Only provided fields will be updated.

Args:
  - group_id (string): The contact group ID to update (required)
  - name (string): Contact group name
  - pos (number): Position/order in the list

Returns:
  The updated contact group.

group_id.description: The contact group ID to update

name: holded_invoicing_update_contact_group
title: Update Holded Contact Group
